entwurf.thema: Claude MCP: connecting tools so you stop copy-pasting

teile.name: Hook
teile.text: Copy, paste, copy, paste. Drowning in tabs. Claude's MCP could cut that, but there's a catch.
teile.szene: Painted open-world-game poster style: tired black-haired presenter in black leather jacket and glowing cyan glasses at a cluttered desk, rubbing his temples, many glowing windows blurred behind him, night lighting, medium shot.

teile.name: What MCP is
teile.text: MCP is an open standard linking AI apps to outside tools and data. Think USB-C port, but for AI.
teile.szene: Close shot of a hand plugging a USB-C cable into a laptop port on a tidy desk, soft daylight, shallow depth of field, calm space above and below.

teile.name: Hypothetical task
teile.text: Hypothetically, a freelancer keeps pasting issue tracker notes into chat. A connected server lets Claude read that system.
teile.szene: Painted open-world-game poster style: the cyan-glasses presenter in black leather jacket sits in a bright city cafe, typing on a laptop, relieved expression as he leans back, warm light, medium shot.

teile.name: Install steps
teile.text: In Claude Desktop, open Settings, Desktop app, Manage Extensions. Browse extensions, pick an Anthropic-reviewed one, and click Install.
teile.szene: Documentation card of the Claude Help Center page on installing desktop extensions, showing the Settings, Extensions and Browse extensions steps, shown large and readable.

teile.name: Setup and check
teile.text: Some extensions need setup, like API keys. After installing, the chat plus button, then Connectors, shows what's connected.
teile.szene: Documentation card from the Claude Help Center showing the section on checking connected MCP servers via the plus button and Connectors, large and readable.

teile.name: The catch
teile.text: So what's the catch? Trust each server. Servers fetching outside content can expose you to prompt injection risk.
teile.szene: Painted open-world-game poster style: the cyan-glasses presenter in black leather jacket pauses with a raised hand before a glowing doorway on a rainy city street, cautious look, dramatic neon light, medium shot.

teile.name: Ending
teile.text: Less copy-pasting. Like, share and save this video.
teile.szene: Painted open-world-game poster style: the cyan-glasses presenter in black leather jacket leans back at a clean desk with one single window open on his laptop, satisfied smile, golden evening light, medium shot.

entwurf.beschreibung: Claude's MCP connects AI apps to outside tools and data. See the documented Claude Desktop install steps, a hypothetical freelancer example and the prompt injection risk to weigh first.
